subject: Re-aligning MAP after org change — new advocate & updated eval timeline
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@healthly.co>
Cc: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com, diego.fernandez@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re-aligning MAP after org change — proposed next steps

Hi Alicia — great to meet you over email and thanks for the heads-up about the re-org. Sorry to hear your previous champion moved teams. I wanted to propose a short re-kickoff so we can reset the mutual action plan (MAP), confirm stakeholders, and align the evaluation timeline so this still fits your Q3 priorities.

Quick summary and asks: 
- I’ve attached an updated MAP (MAP_Healthly_v2.xlsx) with suggested milestones and a condensed evaluation plan.
- Can you confirm the new decision committee (names + roles) and whether security can review the questionnaire this week?
- Proposed next touch: 30-min re-kickoff on Wed 6/23 at 10:00am PT — open to moving.

Immediate deliverables from our side:
- Demo + 1 pager tailored to clinical workflows (diego)
- Filled security questionnaire and SOC 2 summary (neha)
- Pricing outline and commitment levers for dedicated capacity (me)

I’ll keep the invite tentative until you confirm stakeholders/time. Looking forward to helping get this back on track.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference — Customer-first inference at scale

Attachments: MAP_Healthly_v2.xlsx
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@healthly.co>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@healthly.co>, procurement@healthly.co
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Re-aligning MAP after org change — proposed next steps

Hi Vanessa — thanks for reaching out and for the clear plan. I’m stepping in as the new product advocate for this initiative at Healthly. Quick context: our prior lead (Maya Torres) moved to Partnerships, so we need to compress the eval given a board review in mid-July.

Stakeholders I’m looping in:
- Tom Reed, Dir. Engineering (tech lead) — tom.reed@healthly.co
- Procurement (procurement@healthly.co) — for early pricing/contract constraints
- Clinical QA (TBD) — I’ll introduce once available

The Wed 6/23 10:00am PT works for Tom and me. We’ll need the security questionnaire completed beforehand — can your team share a short summary and the SOC 2 extract? Also please confirm if the demo can focus on low-latency inference for short clinical notes.

Thanks — Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Product Manager, Clinical AI | Healthly
Alicia.Gomez@healthly.co

Subject: Re: Re-aligning MAP after org change — security + onboarding plan

Alicia/Vanessa — I’ll take point on the security questionnaire and SOC 2 extract. I’ve attached the latest questionnaire export (security_questionnaire.pdf) and a one-page SOC 2 summary. Short notes:
- We can complete the filled questionnaire and return it by EOD Tue 6/22 if you can send any custom requirements or additional controls you audit against.
- For clinical workloads, we recommend starting on Redwood Dedicated (predictable throughput + VPC options) — we can document data isolation and KMS integrations in the same packet.

Vanessa — I’ll prepare answers to the Healthly-specific items and flag any items that need product/legal.

— Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com

Attachments: security_questionnaire.pdf
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@healthly.co>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Re-aligning MAP after org change — demo focus and tech prep

Hi all — I’ll build the demo deck (demo-deck.pptx) focused on short clinical notes and latency SLOs. A couple of clarifying technical questions so the demo can be realistic:
- Typical note length: ~20-80 tokens (we’ll design batch and KV cache config accordingly)
- Expected concurrency during peak: ~30 concurrent requests (helps size Dedicated pool)
- Any constraints on PHI handling/retention? We’ll show options for on-prem vs VPC + KMS.

If you can confirm the first two by EOD Tue I’ll lock the demo scenarios and run a dry run Wed morning ahead of the 10am PT call.

— Diego Fernandez
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.com

Attachments: demo-deck.pptx
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@healthly.co>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@healthly.co>
Cc: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com, diego.fernandez@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Re-aligning MAP after org change — meeting confirmed (6/23 10:00am PT)

Great — thanks everyone for the quick replies. Confirming the 6/23 10:00am PT re-kickoff (invites sent). Agenda: 1) quick intros & roles, 2) demo focused on short clinical notes (diego), 3) MAP milestones and compressed Q3 timeline, 4) security & procurement questions.

Alicia — noted: Tom will attend as tech lead. Tom, appreciate if you can drop note lengths and concurrency in reply to this thread before the demo so Diego can tailor the scenarios.

Deliverables before the call:
- Security questionnaire (Stephanie) — returned by EOD Tue 6/22 (done)
- Demo deck (Diego) — dry run Wed 8:30am PT
- Updated MAP with compressed milestones (Vanessa) — final attached

Thanks, looking forward to it.

Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
